messages:
Ava (People Ops): Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands — posting the remote/hybrid + travel follow-up here. I'll add the checklist and answer Qs.
Carlos (Office Manager): Quick clarif — are we keeping the 2–3 in-office days recommendation or switching to fully team-defined schedules?
Ava (People Ops): Recommendation stays 2–3 days for most teams. Teams can set a team-defined expectation if both manager and the team agree. Managers should publish team schedules by Apr 1. :calendar:
Ben (Eng): For folks on infra who are mostly remote, will Redwood cover travel for quarterly offsites? We had some confusion.
Dana (CEO): Yes — company covers travel + hotel for quarterly all-team offsites. If you want extra in-person weeks beyond offsite, discuss with your manager; there is discretionary budget per team.
Maya (Product): Is there a per-diem cap for meals during offsites?
Eli (Finance): Per-diem: $60/day domestic, $90/day international. Receipts still required for card charges; personal cards ok with timely Expensify submission.
Ben (Eng): Do flights > $500 need pre-approval? Also any preferred vendor?
Carlos (Office Manager): For trips estimated >$500 please get manager + People Ops sign-off via the travel form: https://intranet.redwood/travel-form
Carlos (Office Manager): We prefer economy (flex allowed if price diff minimal). Use travel@redwood for booking help.
Ava (People Ops): We'll add a short travel checklist to the handbook with links, approvals, and an agenda template for offsite organizers.
hoteling-bot: Desk booking opened for "SF - Main HQ" next week — 25 desks available. Book at /hoteling or https://intranet.redwood/hoteling
Ben (Eng): Hiring question: if candidate wants remote-first, does team need to be remote-friendly or can we hire remote for on-call infra roles?
Dana (CEO): We remain open to remote-first hires for select roles. Hiring managers must document on-site expectations on the job posting (e.g., required HQ visits, minimum quarterly travel). People Ops will surface which roles are remote-eligible.
Maya (Product): Follow-up on partner meals — are lunches with partners expensable without manager pre-approval?
Eli (Finance): Client/partner meals are reimbursable. Submit receipt + brief purpose note. If >$200, loop in your manager when submitting.
Ava (People Ops): Action items recap: 1) People Ops to publish updated travel checklist + offsite agenda template by Mar 31; 2) Office to share weekly hoteling capacity every Monday; 3) Managers to publish team schedules by Apr 1. I'll post updates in this thread when items are live.
Ben (Eng): Thanks — will managers get a reminder nudging them to publish schedules?
Ava (People Ops): Yup, reminder + a short how-to doc on writing team schedules tomorrow.
Maya (Product): One last thing — will people be able to expense coworking passes when traveling for focused work?
Eli (Finance): Coworking passes can be expensed with manager approval and receipt; mark as "coworking" in Expensify.
Ava (People Ops): Anything else? Drop follow-ups here or DM me. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
